name: social-flow
description: Channel-based short-form and long-form content pipeline. Pick the format when you start a storyboard — 9:16 shorts for Threads, Instagram, Facebook and YouTube, or 16:9 YouTube long-form with chapters — then author the storyboard under data/<channel>/episodes/<topic>/, produce the video and the per-platform text, and publish it after a HITL approval gate. Long-form episodes mix clips you film yourself with generated scenes; the shooting script spells out what is on screen, what to do, what to say, and the filename to save it as. Before approval a storyboard clears four adversarial reviewer gates — copy, every scene, word choice, generated images — each at 95 or better with zero P0 defects, and the per-scene gates are judged on the lowest-scoring scene. The autoproduce skill runs the same path unattended, replacing the approval gate with nine machine gates and an economy tier. Per-platform setup and growth skills open the accounts and then run autonomous growth loops. A built-in MCP server ships 46 tools (37 without credentials) — publishing, insights, search, open data, and image, video, voice and music generation — with no external MCP dependency.
